claims.text: The Moana Surfrider opened in 1901 as the first hotel on Waikiki Beach.

findings.quote: Opened on March 11, 1901, as the first hotel on Waikiki Beach, the Moana Surfrider marked the beginning of Waikiki's resort era
findings.note: Confirms the 1901 opening and first-hotel status.

claims.text: The Historic Banyan Wing honors architect Oliver G. Traphagen's original 1901 design, including its Beaux-Arts detailing.

findings.quote: The Historic Banyan Wing honors architect Oliver G. Traphagen's original 1901 design, from the Beaux-Arts detailing to the beautiful crown molding.

claims.text: Tower Wing rooms have a built-in reading nook and a deep lanai that opens the room to Pacific Ocean breezes.

findings.quote: Each features a custom seating and dining area, an integrated refreshment center, a built-in reading nook and a deep lanai that opens the room to the Pacific Ocean breezes.
findings.note: Refers to Tower Wing rooms and suites.

claims.text: The Surfrider Wing has a contemporary design drawn from surf culture, and its oceanfront rooms have rocking chairs with Pacific views.

findings.quote: this light-filled wing nods to that history with a contemporary design drawn from surf culture. Oceanfront rooms feature the beloved rocking chairs with Pacific views

claims.text: The resort has a beachfront stretch of over 600 feet on Waikiki Beach.

findings.quote: The resort has a beachfront stretch of over 600 feet, making it one of the longest stretches of sand in Waikiki.

claims.text: The spa has a whirlpool spa, dry and wet saunas, private relaxation rooms and couples suites.

findings.quote: alongside a whirlpool spa, dry and wet saunas, private relaxation rooms and couples suites.
findings.note: Describes the Moana Lani Spa facilities.

claims.text: Complimentary activities include Storytelling with Tutu, wellness classes, ukulele and hula lessons, and lei making.

findings.quote: Resort guests enjoy a variety of complimentary activities, including Storytelling with Tutu, wellness classes, ukulele and hula lessons, and lei making.

claims.text: The resort runs historical tours about the history of the First Lady of Waikiki.

findings.quote: Historical TourLearn the rich history of the First Lady of Waikiki and hear fascinating stories from back in the day during our bi-weekly historical tours.
findings.note: Confirms the resort runs historical tours.

claims.text: The Veranda's breakfast buffet includes Japanese breakfast selections and mochi waffles.

findings.quote: Our oceanfront restaurant in Waikiki Beach offerings include an omelet station, Japanese breakfast selections and the Moana's signature “beautiful pancakes” and mochi waffles.

claims.text: Guests can take surf and outrigger canoeing lessons.

findings.quote: You can relax to the sound of the waves or jump in for surf and outrigger canoeing lessons.
findings.note: Confirms surf and outrigger canoeing lessons.

claims.text: The Banyan Tree, named Deva, is 75 feet high, stretches 150 feet across and is a millennium landmark tree.

findings.quote: The tree named Deva is a 75-foot-high natural wonder that stretches 150-feet across. She’s a millennium landmark tree
findings.note: Matches the name, height, spread and landmark status.

claims.text: The beachfront pool is set beneath the Banyan Tree.

findings.quote: Set beneath the majestic Banyan Tree and located beachfront, the Moana Surfrider pool offers shade, trade winds and the sound of the Pacific.
findings.note: Confirms the pool is beachfront and beneath the Banyan Tree.

claims.text: Moana Lani Spa's treatments draw on Hawaiian healing practice and include massage, body treatments, facials and nail services.

findings.quote: Treatments draw on Hawaiian healing practice and include massage, body treatments, facials and nail services

claims.text: Carved wooden Moana rocking chairs line the Kalakaua Avenue-facing veranda.

findings.quote: The quintessential Moana tradition, the wooden carved Moana rocking chairs are beloved by all who have entered the resort. Located on the Kalakaua Avenue-facing veranda
findings.note: Confirms the carved wooden rocking chairs on the Kalakaua Avenue-facing veranda.

claims.text: Afternoon Tea is served on the Veranda with oceanfront views.

findings.quote: Indulge in the Moana Surfrider's famous Afternoon Tea sets while taking in beautiful oceanfront views from our patio on the Veranda.
findings.note: Confirms Afternoon Tea on the Veranda with oceanfront views.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the historic building may have smaller rooms than newer resorts.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing due to the beachfront location and historic significance.
